angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 590,649 km at 99.97 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.0026 +/- 0.0125 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 99.97 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.849 +/- 0.004 solar radii from Mantovan et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1533 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract): 590,649 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.88 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Mantovan et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1533 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5146 +/- 81 K from Mantovan et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1533 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mantovan et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1533 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1533.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.525, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1533 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.24 dex, from Mantovan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1533 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.34679, from Mantovan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1533 (pscomppars): age 6.9 Gyr, from Mantovan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1533 (pscomppars): rotation period 20.02 d, from Mantovan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1533 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.5 km/s, from Mantovan et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260630799M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
